propositions: Recursive conftest glob tests/**/conftest.py in global_support causes all seven mutation shards to be selected for any nested conftest change, wasting 322.6 runner-minutes across 97 Verify runs without increasing coverage.

Pytest only loads conftests in a test's directory and its ancestors, never sibling fixture trees; runtime trace across all configured shards identified exactly six ancestor conftests that are actually loaded, not the full recursive glob.
Non-root ancestor conftests must be assigned only to the per-shard support lists of shards whose configured tests actually load them, replacing the recursive global pattern.

A derived ancestry equality contract must verify that each shard's configured test paths expand to exactly their declared ancestor conftests in support, pin all pre-existing non-conftest globals, and fail closed on missing or stale entries.
